# Jawabify

> AI-powered WhatsApp customer messaging for businesses — automate replies, orders, bookings, and campaigns with a multilingual assistant.

Jawabify connects to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and lets businesses run customer support, take orders, send marketing campaigns, and integrate with Shopify, all from one inbox with an AI assistant that learns from your products and FAQs.
